import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.cluster import AgglomerativeClustering

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to expression and copy number features
    expr_ids = [fid for fid, t in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) if t in ('expression', 'copy_number')]
    
    # Remove near-duplicates (correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6)
    correlated_pairs = [
        (a, b) for a, b in [
            ('LBV14', 'BRF16'), ('FWIC14', 'DNM11'), ('NXUR3', 'DLW17'), 
            ('RQV6', 'LBV14'), ('WUY9', 'BRF16'), ('FWIC14', 'DXJE5'), 
            ('DXJE5', 'DNM11'), ('LBV14', 'NHR5'), ('CWWV6B', 'LBV14'), 
            ('WUY9', 'LBV14'), ('EOEY11', 'SOKH19'), ('LBV14', 'KBJO11'), 
            ('MCZ2A', 'RFIQ18'), ('BRF16', 'NHR5'), ('RQV6', 'NHR5'), 
            ('CWWV6B', 'BRF16'), ('KHP6', 'IMJ11'), ('CWWV6B', 'CMGZ19A'), 
            ('WUY9', 'DNM11'), ('RQV6', 'BRF16')
        ] if a in feats.ids and b in feats.ids
    ]
    
    # Keep one feature from each correlated pair
    keep_ids = set(expr_ids)
    for a, b in correlated_pairs:
        if a in keep_ids and b in keep_ids:
            # Prefer higher mean_y1-mean_y0 difference
            idx_a = feats.column(a)
            idx_b = feats.column(b)
            mean_diff_a = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_a]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_a])
            mean_diff_b = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx_b]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx_b])
            if abs(mean_diff_a) < abs(mean_diff_b):
                keep_ids.remove(a)
            else:
                keep_ids.remove(b)
    
    # Cluster remaining features by correlation
    if len(keep_ids) < 2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
        
    keep_ids_list = sorted(list(keep_ids))
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in keep_ids_list]]
    
    # Compute correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(X.T)
    # Use negative correlation for clustering
    similarity = 1 - np.abs(corr_matrix)
    
    # Hierarchical clustering
    clusterer = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=2, linkage='average')
    clusters = clusterer.fit_predict(similarity)
    
    # Select best cluster based on mean_y difference
    best_cluster = 0
    if np.sum(clusters == 1) > 0:
        mean_diff_0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, :][:, clusters==0].mean(axis=1)) - \
                     np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, :][:, clusters==0].mean(axis=1))
        mean_diff_1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, :][:, clusters==1].mean(axis=1)) - \
                     np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, :][:, clusters==1].mean(axis=1))
        best_cluster = 1 if abs(mean_diff_1) > abs(mean_diff_0) else 0
    
    # Select features in best cluster
    selected_ids = [fid for i, fid in enumerate(keep_ids_list) if clusters[i] == best_cluster]
    
    if not selected_ids:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Compute weighted score using mean differences
    loadings = {}
    for fid in selected_ids:
        idx = feats.column(fid)
        mean_diff = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx])
        loadings[fid] = mean_diff
    
    # Normalize loadings
    norm = np.sqrt(sum(v**2 for v in loadings.values()))
    if norm > 0:
        for k in loadings:
            loadings[k] /= norm
    
    # Drivers are top features by mean difference
    drivers = tuple(sorted(selected_ids, key=lambda x: abs(loadings[x]), reverse=True)[:MAX_DRIVERS])
    
    # Columns include all selected features
    columns = tuple(selected_ids)
    
    # No products for this simple model
    products = ()
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=products, loadings=loadings)
